description:
TradePulse: Global trade intelligence API. AI-synthesized tariff rates, HS code classification, FTA duty analysis, landed cost calculation, trade compliance guidance, sanctions screening, market entry analysis, a

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • classify ($0.15): HS code classification
  • tariff ($0.12): Tariff rates by HS code and country pair
  • landed ($0.15): Full landed cost calculator
  • fta ($0.15): Free Trade Agreement analyzer
  • sanctions ($0.12): Sanctions and trade restrictions screening
  • market ($0.15): Market entry intelligence
  • compliance ($0.15): Export compliance — EAR/ITAR/dual-use
  • freight-rates ($0.10): Live freight rate intelligence by lane
  • nearshore ($0.20): Nearshoring and reshoring advisor
  • supplier-risk ($0.15): Supplier country risk — UFLPA, ESG, and geopolitical
  • incoterms ($0.10): Incoterms 2020 decoder
  • news ($0.08): Trade policy intelligence

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: classify | tariff | landed | fta | sanctions | market | compliance | freight-rates | nearshore | supplier-risk | incoterms | news

checks.description: forced_labor | esg | sanctions | geo_risk | all (default: all)

country.description: Country to screen — e.g. Russia, Iran, Cuba, Myanmar, Belarus

current_country.description: Current manufacturing/sourcing country — e.g. China, India, Bangladesh

destination.description: Destination port city or country — e.g. Los Angeles, Hamburg, Sydney

entity.description: Company or individual name to screen

from_country.description: Exporting country — e.g. China, Vietnam, Germany, Mexico. Also accepts 'from'

industry.description: Industry or product sector — e.g. electronics, textiles, automotive parts

lang.description: Response language code (en, zh, ja, de, fr, es, ar, hi, etc.)

origin.description: Origin port city or country — e.g. Shanghai, Rotterdam, Los Angeles

product.description: Natural language product description — e.g. 'laptop computer', 'cotton t-shirts', 'industrial water pump'

quantity.description: Number of units (for per-unit cost calculation)

sector.description: textiles | electronics | food | chemicals | automotive | mining | any (default: any)

target_country.description: Target market country. Also accepts 'country' or 'to'

target_market.description: Primary market you sell into (default: USA)

term.description: Incoterms 2020 rule — EXW | FCA | FAS | FOB | CFR | CIF | CPT | CIP | DAP | DPU | DDP

to_country.description: Importing country — e.g. USA, Japan, Germany, Australia. Also accepts 'to'

topic.description: tariffs | fta | sanctions | wto | supply-chain | all

name: tradepulse
